title: Citrus and rosemary linen spray
subtitle: A light misting spray for pillowcases, towels, and sheets
excerpt: Citrus and rosemary linen spray is a light misting spray made from distilled water, vodka, and lemon and rosemary essential oils. Sprayed onto pillowcases, towels, or freshly ironed sheets, it leaves a clean, herby citrus scent that fades within an hour to a fresher baseline. Makes 100 ml in a small glass spray bottle; keeps six months.
sourceNotes: Linen sprays: household tradition documented in Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management (1861). Vodka as an odourless alcohol carrier for essential oil linen sprays: The Complete Book of Essential Oils and Aromatherapy by Valerie Wormwood (1991). Lemon essential oil flash point ~47°C, the vodka carrier helps disperse the essential oil on fabric fibres and the alcohol evaporates quickly. Rosemary essential oil flash point ~62°C.

recipe.batchNotes: Scale up and fill multiple small bottles.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Ready to use immediately. Shake before each use.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Six months at room temperature. Keep in a dark glass bottle to slow essential oil degradation from UV. Shake before use.

glossaryTerms.definition: The temperature at which an essential oil can ignite if exposed to a flame. Lemon essential oil has a relatively low flash point (~47°C). The vodka carrier disperses the oil in a fine mist on fabrics rather than concentrating it, which is safe for normal use.

items.prepNote: plain unflavoured vodka (40% ABV); the carrier for the essential oils; add the oils to the vodka first before the water
distilled or filtered water; tap water may leave mineral spots on some fabrics
~1% of total volume; the primary citrus note; add to the vodka before adding water
~0.5% of total volume; adds a herby sharpness that complements the lemon

content.text: Pour the vodka into the spray bottle first. Add both essential oils to the vodka and swirl to mix. Add the distilled water. Seal and shake. The spray may look slightly cloudy, the oils disperse in the water-alcohol mixture and are normal.

Shake the bottle, then mist lightly onto pillowcases, towels, and sheets from 20 to 30 cm away. Allow to dry fully before use, a damp pillow from over-spraying is unpleasant. Two or three spritzes per pillowcase is enough; the spray is light and concentrated. Can also be sprayed in the air above the bed just before making it.
Six months at room temperature in a dark glass bottle. Shake before every use. Keep away from heat sources.
